ifc_inspection.notes: Building correctly has exactly 2 storeys (Ground Floor at 0, Upper Floor at 3000mm). Roof placed on Upper Floor level to avoid creating third storey. 10 windows (double the requirement), 23 walls (more interior partitions), 6 doors. All IFC elements present with correct hierarchy.

visual_inspection.floor_plan: Ground floor shows Entry, Kitchen, Living Room, Stair areas with additional windows (North wall in living, East wall in circulation). Upper floor shows Hallway, Bathroom, Master Bedroom, Bedroom 2, and Stair Landing. More interior walls creating better room separation.
visual_inspection.elevations: North elevation shows 2 windows per floor. East elevation shows multiple windows. Building shows proper 2-story massing. More windows visible across all elevations compared to blind version.
visual_inspection.section: Section A-A shows both floors with floor slabs, interior partitions, and windows visible in section cut. Same quality as blind version.

reasoning: Building meets all requirements with 100% test pass rate. Key improvements over blind builder: (1) Roof placed on upper floor level instead of separate level, resulting in exactly 2 IfcBuildingStorey elements as required. (2) Added more interior walls (23 vs 18), generating more wall lines in DXF to pass the 50-line threshold. (3) Added 10 windows (vs 5 in blind) with additional windows on North wall for living room, East wall for circulation, West wall for master bedroom, and extra windows in bedroom 2. The test-aware builder clearly used test feedback to fix the storey count issue and ensure adequate wall geometry in drawings. Visual inspection confirms correct two-story layout with all programmed spaces, proper door swings, window placements, and complete drawing set.
